description:
You'll be amazed what this bike can do!
Whether your mission statement is racing cross, grinding gravel, commuting or light touring, you've found the right tool.
Designed to be a "virtual road bike" when ridden with smaller, high-performance road tires
Geometry optimized for gravel and 'cross riding, and for panniers (up to 40 pounds)
Bottom bracket height is "road bike height" with 28mm tires
Generous tire clearance (up to 45mm) to take on gravel or loose trails, or for comfortable load carrying
Designed for hydraulic or mechanical flat-mount disc brakes (with full length cables)
Brushed Finish (not bead blasted) This can add hundreds of dollars to other frames!
Machined Head Tube and Bottom Bracket shell
Welded 7cm Titanium Insert in top of Seat Tube (strengthens frame and allows 27.2mm seat post in an oversize seat tube)
142 x 12mm thru-axle titanium dropouts
Bosses for rack & fender mounting
Welded Water Bottle Lugs (no rivet to loosen)
"No Noodle" design - frame flex stops here! A must for big, strong 'cross riders
All frames are fully hand-prepped prior to shipment
5-year warranty against defects in material and workmanship
1/2 price "crash replacement" program
14 day 100% money back guarantee

components.description: 44EC / 44 ZS (44mm External Cup lower / 44mm Zero Stack upper) Supports tapered or straight steer tube forks for tuning the ride to your needs
Top Tube: 34.9mm OD; Down Tube: 45mm Butted; Seat Tube: 32mm OD - Seat Stay: 17mm Tapered (S-bent) - Chain Stay: 27-tapered to 17mm (S-bent)
